contexts.finding: Peripheral challenges evoked neural readouts, while selected neural manipulations changed circulating cytokines. Activation improved high-dose endotoxin survival but increased bacterial tissue load in a different live-infection protocol. A complete descending immune circuit is not identified.
limitations: Both male and female mice at least seven weeks old were used; exact age and sex distributions per assay group are not supplied. No randomized animal allocation, blinded investigation or prospective statistical sample-size calculation is reported. The reporting summary discusses stimulus ordering separately; it does not establish randomized animal groups.

FOS labeling is an activity-associated marker; Vglut2-cre bulk GCaMP6s is a population calcium signal, not a DBH-specific spike recording. Photometry uses saline on day 4 and LPS on day 5 in the same animals. Vagotomized mice form a separate group after two weeks of recovery; a matched abdominal sham is not explicitly specified in the reviewed procedure. Figure 1c reports residual responses after an approximately 80% reduction.

LPS doses differ across assays: 50 micrograms/kg for FOS and TRAP, 0.5 mg/kg for the main photometry comparison, 0.1 mg/kg for cytokine chemogenetics and 12.5 mg/kg for survival. These exposures are not interchangeable. LPS endotoxaemia is distinct from viable bacterial infection.

Fos-based TRAP2 labeling is followed by at least four weeks before functional rechallenge to restore LPS sensitivity. LPS-TRAPed, Dbh-cre, Vglut2-cre and Vgat-cre populations are not identical. Dbh expression does not measure norepinephrine release or identify a unique molecular mediator.

For standard cytokine chemogenetics, Methods specify CNO at 2 mg/kg twelve hours and 1 mg/kg one hour before challenge; schematics and captions show only the one-hour pretreatment. mCherry controls receive CNO. Saline/LPS tests use the same cohort at least seven days apart, whereas hM3Dq/hM4Di versus mCherry comparisons use separate groups. Blood ELISA at two hours does not identify cytokine-producing cells.

Cre-defined nodose activation perturbs marker-defined neurons; it is not selective activation of the TRPA1 channel or CALCA peptide. TRPA1 neurons include different stimulus-responsive subgroups. Extended Data 8e shows two IL-10/fat co-responders among 63 neurons, which the authors did not consider further. Universal zero overlap is unsupported.

Injected cytokines and extraintestinal perfusion have different doses, routes and recording windows. The response classifier uses baseline median absolute deviation, a mean modified z-score above 1.6 and peak fluorescence of at least 1%. Selected, normalized responder heatmaps are not an unbiased full-population distribution. In vivo responses do not establish direct cytokine binding to a neuronal receptor; epithelial or immune intermediates remain possible. Referenced imaging procedures have not been fully audited.

Survival experiments use separate Trpa1-cre nodose and Dbh-cre cNST cohorts after high-dose LPS, with repeated 5 mg/kg CNO dosing. Figure 6 shows survival through nine days, not a lifelong or clinical outcome. Separate infection experiments use oral Salmonella and eight CNO injections beginning twelve hours before inoculation; bacterial load is measured in spleen and mesenteric lymph nodes at day five.

Nonsignificance is not equivalence or proof of no pathway contribution. The corticosterone null is a two-hour circulating concentration, not complete exclusion of hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal mediation. Extended Data 3 reuses the Figure 2c saline/LPS data; it is not an independent replication.

The cNST transcriptomic atlas pools tissue from five animals; 4,008 cells and expression clusters are not independent animal replicates, anatomical coordinates or a measured connectome. Rabies labeling supports an anatomical input interpretation, not synaptic efficacy. Main text calls the rabies reporter dsRed while Methods and Extended Data 12 specify GFP; panel 12d depicts Trpa1 but repeats Calca in its quantitative caption. No tracing fraction is calibrated.

Descending efferent routes and immune effector cells remain unresolved. A whole-animal Myd88 knockout does not isolate immune-cell-specific mediation. Lower circulating inflammatory cytokines do not imply universally better defense: sustained TRPA1-population activation increased Salmonella tissue burden in the separate live-infection assay.

Raw measurements, animal identifiers and custom code have not been obtained or replayed. Exclusion criteria include unsuccessful targeting/expression/ablation, but counts and operational thresholds are incomplete. Extended Data 9c reports Gpr65 IL-6 P=0.03 despite a broad no-appreciable-effect conclusion; its small plotted decrease must not be turned into an all-population null. No numerical edge weight or universal carrier count is assigned.

The DSS Methods specify CNO in the experimental cohort drinking solution, while Figure 6 says all animals received CNO. Matched control exposure and intake need resolution before a selective DSS mechanism is admitted. This issue does not change the separately described injected-CNO LPS or infection protocols.

contexts.finding: The reported picture-category contrasts depend on region, frequency, summary and preprocessing.
limitations: Twenty-nine patients were recruited; one accuracy and six electrode-location exclusions leave twenty-two. Electrode placement follows clinical need. The four selected regions do not define a complete or minimal empathy circuit.

The 0-500 ms analysis excludes the later response period, but does not isolate all attention, motor preparation or salience effects. Nonsignificant accuracy and reaction-time contrasts are not equivalence tests.

contexts.correctionCheck: Publisher metadata, the author-lab PDF and publisher supplementary PDF, and exact DOI correction, erratum and retraction searches were checked on 14 September 2026. No notice resolving the stated dose, reporter or denominator conflicts was identified. This is not exhaustive correction surveillance.
contexts.finding: PV activation suppresses population cycle markers and PV inhibition increases them; tested SST/VIP manipulations retain nulls. Conditional gamma2 deletion changes early activation and later clone composition. Isolation retains an EdU difference under PV activation, while MCM2 housing contrasts are nonsignificant. Full feedback closure and exclusive mediation remain unresolved.
limitations: Adult mouse preparations use nestin-GFP, PV/SST/VIP-Cre and nestin-CreERT2;Z/EG lines with gamma2-floxed or control alleles. Sex and a complete group-specific animal manifest are not reported. Tamoxifen is a single 62 mg/kg intraperitoneal dose at 6-10 weeks. The Methods require at least four weeks after AAV surgery; schematic week labels do not supply exact ages for every animal.

Acute 300-micrometre slices were recorded at 32-34 degrees C, with RGL voltage clamp at -65 mV and 5 mM kynurenic acid. The internal solution is ambiguously printed as 135 mM CsCl gluconate. Clamp-current sign does not directly identify native membrane polarization, spiking or cell-cycle entry.

Main text, Online Methods and Supplementary Figure 1 print 200 mM for focal GABA/muscimol application; no micromolar substitution is made. Etomidate is 100 nM in the main text/Figure 1 but 10 micromolar in Methods. The etomidate dose remains unresolved, and pharmacological sensitivity does not establish receptor stoichiometry.

Population experiments use five consecutive days of stimulation, eight hours per day: ChR2 blue light at 472 nm, 5-ms pulses at 8 Hz for 30 seconds every five minutes, or continuous 593-nm eNpHR light. AAV volume, delivered light power and a full opsin-negative illumination control are not reported. No-light sham comparisons include the effects of the complete light protocol.

On day five, EdU is injected intraperitoneally at 41.1 mg/kg six times, two hours apart, with collection two hours after the last injection. Repeated injections are not independent replicates. EdU incorporation and MCM2 expression are cycle-related endpoints, not counts of completed neuronal differentiation, integrated neurons or an instantaneous birth rate.

Population scoring uses 40-micrometre sections, every sixth section, and nestin-positive inverted-Y morphology over an EdU- or MCM2-positive nucleus. Optogenetic counts are limited to one millimetre anterior and posterior to the injection. Densities per cubic millimetre and the MCM2-positive fraction have distinct denominators. Analyses are described as blinded; random assignment, raw unit records and multiplicity-adjusted tests are not supplied.

At two and seven days after induction, one GFP-positive RGL is classified as a quiescent clone and two or more nuclei as an activated clone. These are fixed-tissue, spatially assigned clones using a referenced method, not live observations of every division or independently verified common ancestry. Supplementary Figure 2d plots one dentate gyrus per dot; hemispheres and clones cannot automatically be treated as independent animals.

Gamma2 immunostaining is shown in RGLs, but Supplementary Figure 2f electrophysiology tests GFP-positive neurons at thirty days, not RGLs. Its seven-of-ten cKO response pattern is not a measured RGL deletion efficiency. Recombination can persist in descendants, so later survival or differentiation may contribute to clone composition.

Thirty-day Figure 3f and Supplementary Figure 3e use incompletely reconciled clone denominators: the supplementary pie categories omit single-R and no-R classes. N includes intermediate progenitors or neurons, not exclusively mature neurons. Exact class percentages must not be pooled or converted to transition probabilities.

The population diazepam protocol is 5 mg/kg intraperitoneally once daily for five days. The clonal drug comparison instead uses six daily doses after tamoxifen and analysis at seven days. Diazepam is systemic. Pairwise drug responses or nulls without a reported genotype-by-drug interaction do not isolate an exclusive cell-autonomous mediator.

Social isolation starts immediately after weaning and lasts at least six weeks before labeling. The two housing conditions are crossed with light versus sham; this is not a selective learning manipulation. PV activity and extracellular GABA are not measured as the intervening response to isolation in the same animals.

Figure 5c retains higher EdU-positive RGL density in isolated versus group-housed animals under PV light stimulation (reported P < 0.05). In that same housing comparison, MCM2-positive density and fraction are nonsignificant (P > 0.1). These endpoints do not support complete abolition of the isolation effect or equivalence; the light-treated group is also distinct from the untreated group-housed baseline.

Figure 4 population comparisons use three or four animals per condition; Figure 5c uses four. Reported Student t-tests do not provide an equivalence margin, complete unit manifest or a formal factorial interaction. SST/VIP nulls apply to the tested lines, protocols and readouts, not all possible interneuron functions.

No matched experiment follows physiological circuit demand through PV signaling, RGL division, newborn-neuron survival and functional integration to restoration of circuit output. Supplementary Figure 8 imports schematic connectivity proportions, not measured weights. A reported reconstruction covering over 200 RGLs is spatial coverage, not 200 verified functional contacts or a minimum carrier count. Movie legends were read; movie files and custom reconstruction code were not replayed.

All six main PDF pages, Figures 1-5, Online Methods and all nine supplementary PDF pages with Figures 1-8 and Movie 1-3 legends were reviewed. Raw animal-level data, microscopy, recordings, movie files and analysis code were not obtained or independently reproduced.
